name: capabilities_search
description: Scoped by the BeatAPI family server at runtime.

query.description: What the user wants, as platform + action in their own words, Chinese or English: "小红书 搜索笔记", "B站 视频评论", "instagram user posts", "image model", "决策". Only a platform name ("小红书") returns an overview; leave it empty for the catalogue map.

kind.description: Optional filter. model: text, image, video and decision models. data: social media and web data. workflow: multi-step media jobs.

platform.description: Optional platform filter, slug or name: xiaohongshu or 小红书, douyin or 抖音, tiktok, bilibili or B站, weibo or 微博, x, instagram, youtube.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous reply, to get the next page.

view.description: compact: one short card per result. full: complete contracts; rarely needed, use capabilities_inspect on one reference instead.

group_by.description: function: group the matches by what they do (search, content, comments, users, trends, feeds, commerce, live) with examples in each group.

name: capabilities_inspect
description: Scoped by the BeatAPI family server at runtime.

reference.description: A reference copied exactly from capabilities_search results or from suggestions, such as data:xiaohongshu.app_v2.search_notes or model:jev-1.13-free. Never build one yourself.

name: capabilities_run
description: Scoped by the BeatAPI family server at runtime.

reference.description: The inspected reference, copied exactly. For status and result, the same reference as the start.

operation.description: start: run it. status: check an async task (needs task_id; takes view like start). result: fetch a finished result again, free within 1 hour (needs request_id).

input.description: For start: the input, following the inspected input_schema; unknown fields are rejected. Text models: {"input":"<prompt or messages array>"} plus optional instructions, max_output_tokens, temperature. JEV: {"state":"<situation>","questions":{...}}.

task_id.description: For status: the task id an async start returned.

request_id.description: For result: the request_id a sync start returned.

view.description: preview: the result's main list lifted to items (max_items elements, each trimmed inside), long strings shortened, marked truncated with a result_ref. full: the whole result, which can be tens of kilobytes.

max_items.description: With view preview: elements kept in items (default 10, at most 50).

fields.description: Return only these paths. Paths starting items[] are read from each element of the result's list and come back as items; other paths are dotted from the result root, [] walks an array. Example: ["items[].title", "items[].url"].

idempotency_key.description: A unique key per task, sent here as a top-level argument (not inside input). Reuse it only to retry the same start, so the retry does not run or charge twice.
